claude_only.name: Which identifier is authoritative for this agreement, who issued it, and is it agreed by all parties?
Does this record denote one binding agreement, or a framework whose obligations arise only on call-off?
How is a specific executed version of this agreement addressed as distinct from the abstract agreement?
If no master-system identifier exists, which Dimension minted the surrogate key and under what authority?
What class of subject matter does the agreement govern, and under which classification scheme is that code drawn?
Are all parties acting in the exercise of their trade or profession, so that the commercial-contract scope applies?
Does the CISG or another uniform regime apply to this agreement, and has it been expressly excluded?
Which law did the parties designate to govern the contract, and is the designation express or tacit?
Is the choice-of-law term recorded as severable, so that a defect in the main agreement does not invalidate it?
Which overriding mandatory rules or unfair-term controls apply irrespective of the chosen law?
Does the chosen law cover interpretation, performance and remedies, or is the contract split across several laws?
Is the agreed forum a national court, an arbitral tribunal, or a staged escalation ending in one of them?
What evidence shows the arbitration agreement is in writing as required for cross-border enforcement?
What escalation stage has the dispute reached and when did each stage begin?
Under what condition does the forum obtain access to the otherwise confidential record?
What role does each party position hold, and from which controlled vocabulary is the role code taken?
Where several obligors occupy one side, are their duties joint, several, or joint and several?
How is a party position kept distinct from the legal entity that currently occupies it?
Which governed global identifier denotes each party, and what is its current registration status?
What is each party's relevant place of business, and how was it determined where several exist?
What evidence supports the link between the named party in the text and the identified legal entity?
How is a party's change of name, registration or legal form recorded without breaking the position link?
On what basis was each signatory empowered to bind the party, and where is that basis recorded?
What monetary, subject-matter or duration limits bound the signatory's authority at execution time?
If authority was exceeded, is the agreement treated as ratified, void, or binding on apparent authority?
Was signing authority verified before execution, by whom, and at what observation time?
Which non-principal positions exist, and what right or exposure does each carry?
May a named beneficiary enforce a term directly, and can the parties vary it without that beneficiary's consent?
May an obligor perform through a subcontractor, and does the obligor remain liable for that performance?
By what act was the contract concluded: acceptance of a definite offer, conduct indicating assent, or an automated exchange?
At what dispatch and receipt times did the concluding communication take effect, in each party's offset?
Whose standard terms were incorporated, and how was a conflict between competing form sets resolved?
Was the proposal sufficiently definite as to goods, quantity and price for a binding contract to arise?
Does any applicable rule require this agreement or a clause within it to be in writing or signed?
What signature or seal type was used by each signatory, and at what assurance level?
What validation evidence proves the signature was valid at signing time and remains verifiable now?
When and in which offset did each party execute, and which execution completed the agreement?
Which conditions had to be satisfied or waived before obligations became enforceable, and what is each one's status?
How does the effective date differ from the execution date, and does any term apply retroactively?
Is any ground of invalidity asserted, such as mistake, fraud, threat or gross disparity, and by whom?
If a term is invalid or unenforceable, does the remainder of the agreement survive?
How is a single provision addressed so the reference survives renumbering in a later amended version?
What functional class does a provision belong to, and which classification scheme assigns it?
What digest fixes the exact wording of a provision as executed?
Which machine-readable rule, if any, is asserted to represent this provision, and who asserted it?
Which documents, schedules and incorporated term sets together constitute the contract?
In what rank order do the constituent documents prevail when their terms conflict?
Which language version is authentic, and what status do translations have?
Is the price fixed, indexed, cost-plus, or determined by a mechanism, and what inputs drive it?
When does payment fall due relative to delivery, invoice or acceptance, and over what period?
What interest, charge or suspension right arises on late payment, and from which date does it run?
Is the price treated as restricted, so that it is withheld from non-party projections?
Which trade term applies, of which edition, and to which named place or port?
At which event and moment does risk in the goods pass from seller to buyer?
Within what period must the goods or services be examined and non-conformity notified?
Where is the passing of property recorded, given that this model and the uniform sales regime exclude it?
What ceiling and exclusions limit each party's liability, and which heads of loss are carved out?
What is warranted, for how long, and what is the exclusive remedy for a warranty breach?
What information is confidential, for how long after termination, and which disclosures are permitted?
Has any term been screened as unilaterally imposed and potentially unfair under applicable controls?
Is this norm an obligation, a permission, a prohibition or a right, and who bears it?
Which provision creates this duty, and does any other provision qualify or defeat it?
What counts as violation of this duty, and what penalty or reparation is chained to it?
What is the current state of the duty: not yet due, due, performed, waived, or violated?
Is the duty triggered by a fixed date, an elapsed period, or the occurrence of another event?
How long is any grace or cure period, and from which notice or event does it run?
Is timely performance treated as essential, so that delay alone justifies avoidance?
Which milestones depend on the completion of others, and what happens when an upstream one slips?
What evidence shows that a specific obligation was performed, and who produced it?
Against which agreed metric was performance measured, and what value was observed?
Did the counterparty accept, reject or accept with reservations, and within what period?
When did performance actually occur, and when was it recorded in the system?
Is the non-performance fundamental, so that avoidance is available, or merely a delay or defect?
Is an excuse asserted on grounds of impediment beyond control or of hardship, and with what evidence?
Which remedy has the aggrieved party elected: performance, price reduction, damages, or avoidance?
How is the claimed loss quantified, and is it capped or liquidated by an agreed term?
Which provisions does the amendment insert, replace or delete, and what new expression results?
What formality does the contract require for a variation to be effective, and was it met?
From when does the amendment take effect, and does it apply to obligations already due?
How does a reader of an old clause reference reach the corresponding provision in the amended text?
Is the transfer an assignment of rights, a transfer of obligations, or a novation of the whole position?
Whose consent was required for the transfer, and what evidences that consent?
Does a change of control of a party trigger a notification duty or a termination right?
After transfer, does the party position identifier persist while the occupying entity changes?
Which channels and addresses are valid for a formal notice under this contract?
When was the notice dispatched and when is it deemed received under the agreed or default rule?
What kind of notice is this, and which contractual consequence does it start?
What evidence proves delivery of the notice to the designated address?
Did the agreement end by full performance, expiry of term, notice, avoidance for breach, or mutual release?
Which provisions survive the end of the agreement, and for how long?
What wind-down duties remain: return or deletion of materials, final accounting, transition assistance?
What status does the record take after termination, and when does it become eligible for disposition?
Which agent is responsible for each assertion in the record, and on whose behalf did it act?
From which source document or message was each derived value obtained, and by what method?
Are the time the contractual fact occurred and the time it entered the record kept distinct throughout?
How is the executed text verified as unaltered, and what happens when verification fails?
Which grant permits a reader to see a given bundle, layer, finding or artifact, and for what purpose?
On what grounds may the record be disclosed to a forum, regulator or auditor without party consent?
Which elements must be redacted before disclosure outside the parties, and how is redaction proven complete?
Which facts are joint, so that no single party may change or release them unilaterally?
Which event starts the retention clock, and what period applies to each class of element?
What limitation period governs claims under this agreement, and does it exceed the retention period?
Is a legal hold or dispute suspending disposition, who imposed it, and when may it be lifted?
How is a personal-data erasure request reconciled with the duty to preserve executed contractual evidence?
Which external vocabularies are aligned to this model, and is the claim alignment or tested conformance?
What does each published projection expose, and which elements does it deliberately omit?
Where two aligned standards model the same concept differently, which mapping governs and why?
How current is a published projection, and at what observation time was it generated?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier of this agreement, which system minted it, and what governed IRI or Dimension UUID or ULID is attached if the master id is absent or not globally unique?
Which FRBR level is being operated on: the abstract agreement, a particular amended or language expression, a signed manifestation, or a stored item, and how do those levels link?
What content hash and counterpart grouping identify the exact signed or otherwise authentic text so that later projections can be checked without treating a copy as a new agreement?
Which agent or system first registered this identity, at what observation or ingestion time, and is that distinct from the legal execution event time?

What is the contract type and subject-matter class, and is the preponderant obligation a sale of goods, a supply of services or labour, or another commercial class such as licence, loan or distribution?
Do the parties have places of business in different States such that CISG Article 1 is engaged, have the parties excluded CISG under Article 6, and do any Article 2–5 exclusions apply?
Is each party acting in the exercise of its trade or profession, and is the contract therefore outside consumer and employment regimes that this model excludes?
Which State law or generally accepted rules of law did the parties choose, was the choice express or tacit, and does it apply to the whole contract or to identified parts?
Was the choice of law made or modified after conclusion, at what event time, and were formal validity and third-party rights preserved as HCCH Article 2(3) requires?
Which overriding mandatory rules or public policy of the forum or a closely connected State limit the chosen law, and does the forum allow non-State rules of law in court as well as in arbitration?

If CISG governs and a matter is not settled in it, which general CISG principles or residual applicable law fill the gap, and how is that residual law identified without treating the choice-of-court clause as a choice of law?
Which party positions exist on this agreement, what role does each play, and to which organization or person referent does each position point?
What is each party's relevant place of business or habitual residence, and which establishment has the closest relationship to the contract and its performance?
Who signed or otherwise manifested assent for each position, in what capacity, and which charter, power of attorney or agency instrument is referenced as the authority check?
Do the parties hold the agreement record jointly, and is any party a mere disclosed agent, undisclosed principal, or guarantor rather than a primary obligor?

When did the offer reach the offeree, when was acceptance dispatched and when did it reach the offeror, and at what event time was the contract concluded, as distinct from when those communications were ingested into the record?
Did any reply add or change terms, were those terms material under CISG Article 19(3) or the circumstances, and did the offeror object without undue delay?
Was the contract concluded by performance or other conduct without an identifiable offer and acceptance, or by an agreed automated system, and what conduct is sufficient to show agreement?
Was the offer stated to be irrevocable or reasonably relied upon, and did a revocation reach the offeree before acceptance was dispatched?

Does CISG Article 11 apply, has an Article 96 declaration restored a writing requirement, or does a domestic statute such as UCC § 2-201 require a signed writing, and which exception if any makes the agreement enforceable without it?
How was assent signed or otherwise authenticated, which reliability criteria under the UNCITRAL Model Law on Electronic Signatures were met, and which party position is bound by each signature?
Did a party insist that the contract is not concluded until a particular form or final document is executed, and has that form been completed?
If the record is electronic, which functional-equivalence rules treat it as writing and as a signature, and is any paper original still the controlling manifestation?
What is the stable citation path and identifier of each addressable provision, and which parent hierarchy does it sit in?
Which terms are standard terms of one party and which were negotiated, and did those standard terms become part of the contract through acceptance, confirmation or usage?
Which formal LegalRuleML or equivalent statements are isomorphic to which textual provisions, including many-to-many links?
Which expression of the instrument contains this clause after amendment, and is editorial markup distinguished from authorial text?
For a disputed statement or clause, did the other party know or could it not have been unaware of the speaker's intent, and if not what would a reasonable person of the same kind have understood?
Which agreed usages, established practices between the parties, or widely known international trade usages are implied into the contract unless excluded?
What subsequent conduct of the parties is to be considered in interpretation, and which negotiation records are in the interpretation file rather than in the four corners of the instrument?
Is each commitment an obligation, permission, prohibition or right, who is the bearer and who if anyone is the auxiliary party?
From which clauses does the duty arise, what due condition or time makes it performable, and what is its current performance status?

For a sales contract, are the CISG Article 30 seller duties to deliver, hand over documents and transfer property, and the Article 53 buyer duties to pay and take delivery, all instantiated as obligations or has a party derogated from them?
What date, period or reasonable-time rule governs each performance, and at which place must delivery or other performance occur?
What price, currency and determination method apply, and if the contract is silent does CISG Article 55 or another gap-filler supply the price generally charged at conclusion?
Where and when must payment be made, is a request or formality required, and which invoice or documentary conditions precede payment?
What acceptance criteria attach to each milestone or deliverable, and which obligations does that milestone pace?
Did the goods or other performance match the required quantity, quality, description, purpose, sample and packaging, and what examination was done and when?
Was lack of conformity notified within a reasonable time and within any two-year or guarantee limit, and has the counterparty accepted, rejected or taken delivery under reservation?
Did the performing party cure missing quantity, replacement or repair before or after the due date without unreasonable inconvenience or expense, and did the receiving party retain a damages claim?
What evidence record discharges or refuses the obligation, at what performance event time, and when was that evidence ingested?
Has risk passed, by which CISG Article 67–69 event, and were the goods clearly identified to the contract before risk could pass?
Is a failure excused under CISG Article 79 as an impediment beyond control, was notice given in reasonable time, and is the exemption limited to damages for the period of the impediment?
If UNIDROIT hardship or an equivalent clause applies, has a party requested renegotiation, adaptation or termination, and is that path distinct from CISG Article 79 exemption?
Did the claiming party's own act or omission cause the other party's failure so that CISG Article 80 bars reliance on that failure?
What identifier and new expression IRI does this amendment have, which clauses does it change, and at what effective event time does the change operate?
Does the agreement require modifications in writing, and is a party precluded by its conduct from asserting that requirement because the other party relied?
Is the change a formal amendment of joint text, a unilateral waiver of a right, or a termination by agreement, and which party positions consented?
Has a party declared a breach, is it fundamental under CISG Article 25, and was the detriment foreseeable to a reasonable person in the same circumstances?
Has an additional period of reasonable length been fixed, what is its end time, and has the non-performing party offered cure that must be allowed to run?
Has performance been suspended for apparent future non-performance or avoided for clear future fundamental breach, was notice given, and was adequate assurance provided?
If the contract is an instalment contract, does the breach justify avoidance of one instalment, of future instalments, or of interdependent past deliveries as well?
Which remedy is claimed or agreed: specific performance, repair or substitute goods, price reduction, damages, interest, agreed penalty or liquidated damages, or avoidance, and what is its status?
What foreseeable loss including lost profit is claimed, what substitute or current-price differential applies, and by how much must the claim be reduced for failure to mitigate?
Was avoidance declared by notice, which obligations are released, which dispute-settlement and winding-up clauses survive, and what concurrent restitution and benefit accounting is due?
Which limitation or prescription period applies, when did it start, has it been suspended, and does expiry bar the remedy without extinguishing the underlying right?
If specific performance is claimed, would the seized court grant it under its own law for similar domestic contracts as CISG Article 28 allows it to consider?
Which rights or obligations were assigned or novated, from which party position to which assignee, and was consent of the remaining party required and given?
Is there a guarantor party position or a separate guarantee agreement, and did the contract confer enforceable rights on a named third-party beneficiary?
Was the obligor notified of the assignment at what event time, and has any set-off been claimed against the assigned right?
By what method and to which address must notices be given, when did a given notice reach the addressee under CISG Article 24, and is delayed transmission still effective under Article 27?
Does the agreement choose arbitration, a court, or another forum, what is the seat or venue and rules, and is that clause treated as severable from the main contract and from the choice of law?
Who holds a full mirror of the joint record, what consented disclosures of existence or performance standing are in force, and has adjudication access been opened by escalation?

What retention period and legal holds apply to the agreement record and evidence, and by what joint or legally compelled method may a record be deleted, redacted or archived after the limitation period?
Is the agreement record jointly owned by the party positions, and which stewardship or access-grant sibling objects implement grants beyond the party mirrors?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
